status: Informational reference in Configure Mod. Proposed class assignments are not active; existing character accessory permissions remain in use.
basis: Original FFVII item effects checked against outside guides. Proposed class restrictions are a thematic mod adaptation, not canonical FFVII restrictions.
owner_rule: Character ownership follows the selected class. With no eligible selected character: visible, no icons, unusable.
